model.description:
REQUIRED POSITIONAL ARGUMENT. Select the model type: fast, sup, or hac. The choice depends on whether base modification (mods) detection is needed:

- If the user does **not** need mod calling (no detection of base modifications), it is recommended to use **hac** or **fast** models. The main difference between these is speed versus accuracy, so clarify user preference.
- If the user **does** require mod calling (base modification detection), the **sup** model must be used.

Always confirm the user's needs before generating the command, and help select the appropriate model type (fast, hac, or sup).

data.description: REQUIRED POSITIONAL ARGUMENT: Directly provide the data directory or POD5 file path containing raw nanopore signal data to be basecalled. DO NOT prefix with '--data'. This must be a standalone value in the command line sequence.

-x/--device.description: OPTIONAL NAMED OPTION: Specifies the compute device. Unlike positional arguments, this MUST be prefixed with '--device' or '-x'.

--models-directory.description: Directory to search for existing basecalling models or download new models into.

--bed-file.description: Optional BED file. If provided, overlaps between alignments and BED intervals are counted and recorded in BAM output using the 'bh' tag.

-r/--recursive.description: Recursively scan through subdirectories of the data path to find POD5 files.

-l/--read-ids.description: Path to a text file containing a newline-delimited list of read IDs to basecall. If not set, all reads are basecalled.

-n/--max-reads.description: Maximum number of reads to basecall. 0 means process all available reads.

--resume-from.description: Resume basecalling from a previous HTS output file. Already completed read records in that file are not processed again.

--disable-read-splitting.description: Disable automatic splitting of reads into multiple segments.

--min-qscore.description: Minimum mean Q-score threshold. Reads below this are either discarded or written to 'fail' outputs when --output-dir is set.

--emit-moves.description: Emit per-move information into the 'mv' SAM/BAM tag.

--emit-fastq.description: Emit basecalled reads in FASTQ format.

--emit-sam.description: Emit basecalled reads in SAM format.

-o/--output-dir.description: Root output directory for basecalled reads and associated files. If not specified, results are written to stdout where applicable.

--mm2-opts.description: Additional minimap2 options as a single string. For multiple arguments, quote the entire string.

--modified-bases.description: **MUST USE  sup in 'model' parameter model** These are the only supported options for modification(mod) basecalling. For exmaple: If you want to call m5C or 2OmeC, select 'm5C_2OmeC'. If you need to call multiple modifications that are not in the same choice (e.g. m5C and m6A_DRACH), you can combine different choices by separating them with **space**. To perform modcalling, you must use sup in 'model' parameter. If the modification you require is not listed here, it cannot be called.

--modified-bases-models.description: Comma-separated list of modified base model paths corresponding to the requested modified base codes.

--modified-bases-threshold.description: Minimum predicted modification probability (0–1) required to emit a modified base call in all-context models.

--modified-bases-batchsize.description: Batch size used for modified base models during inference.

--kit-name.description: Enable barcoding using the given kit name. Controls which barcodes and trimming rules are applied.

--sample-sheet.description: Path to a sample sheet describing barcodes and sample assignments.

--barcode-both-ends.description: Require both ends of a read to contain valid barcodes for double-ended barcoding kits.

--barcode-arrangement.description: Path to a file describing custom barcode arrangement. Requires --kit-name.

--barcode-sequences.description: Path to a file with custom barcode sequences. Requires --kit-name and --barcode-arrangement.

--primer-sequences.description: Path to FASTA file with custom primer sequences, or the name of a supported third‑party primer set (e.g. 10X_Genomics).

--no-trim.description: Disable trimming of barcodes, adapters and primers. When not set, all three are trimmed by default.

--trim.description: Specify what to trim. 'all' trims adapters, primers and barcodes; 'adapters' trims only adapters; 'none' disables trimming (equivalent to --no-trim). Only applies to DNA; RNA adapters are always trimmed.

--estimate-poly-a.description: Enable estimation of poly(A)/poly(T) tail lengths (beta feature), mainly for cDNA and dRNA use cases.

--poly-a-config.description: Configuration file to adjust default behaviour for poly(A)/poly(T) tail length estimation.

-b/--batchsize.description: Number of chunks per inference batch. 0 lets dorado automatically choose an optimal batch size.

reads.description: Directly input SAM/BAM file produced by dorado basecaller to summarize.

-s/--separator.description: Field separator to use in the summary output.

--model.description: Name of the model to download. Use 'all' to download all available models.

--models-directory.description: Directory into which downloaded models will be written.

--list.description: List the available models for download in a human‑readable table.

--list-yaml.description: List the available models for download as YAML to stdout.

--list-structured.description: List the available models for download in a structured YAML format to stdout.

--data.description: Path to POD5 data used for automatic selection of appropriate models.

-r/--recursive.description: Recursively scan through subdirectories of --data when searching for POD5 files.

--overwrite.description: Overwrite existing model files in the target directory if they already exist.

reads.description: Directly input FASTQ file containing reads to correct.

-t/--threads.description: Number of threads for processing. 0 uses all available threads.

--infer-threads.description: Number of threads per device for inference.

-x/--device.description: Compute device: 'auto', 'cpu', 'cuda:all' or 'cuda:<device_id>[,<device_id>...]'. 'auto' chooses CPU, Metal or CUDA based on availability.

-p/--from-paf.description: Path to PAF file with alignments. Skips alignment computation if provided.

--to-paf.description: Generate PAF alignments and skip consensus generation.

--resume-from.description: Resume from a previously interrupted run. Requires a file with sequence headers in the first column (e.g. .fai index from previous output).

-b/--batch-size.description: Batch size for inference. 0 enables auto batch size detection.

-i/--index-size.description: Size of index for mapping and alignment. Decrease to lower memory usage.

--compute-num-blocks.description: Compute and return the number of index blocks that would be processed in a normal run.

--run-block-id.description: ID of the index block to run. If specified, only this block will be processed.

-o/--output-dir.description: Directly input output folder for demultiplexed reads.

reads.description: Input file or folder containing reads in any HTS format.

-r/--recursive.description: Recursively search subfolders when reads argument is a directory.

--kit-name.description: Barcoding kit name. Cannot be used with --no-classify.

--no-classify.description: Skip barcode classification. Only demux based on existing classification in reads. Cannot be used with --kit-name or --sample-sheet.

-t/--threads.description: Combined number of threads for barcoding and output generation. 0 uses all available threads.

-n/--max-reads.description: Maximum number of reads to process. Mainly for debugging. 0 processes all reads.

-l/--read-ids.description: File with newline-delimited list of reads to demux.

--emit-fastq.description: Output in FASTQ format. Default is BAM.

--emit-summary.description: Emit a summary file with primary alignment details for each read to the root of the output folder.

--barcode-both-ends.description: Require both ends of a read to be barcoded for double-ended barcode kits.

--no-trim.description: Skip barcode trimming. Use this if input data is mapped and you want to preserve mapping information.

--sort-bam.description: Sort BAM output files containing mapped reads. Requires --no-trim to be set.

--barcode-arrangement.description: Path to file with custom barcode arrangement.

--barcode-sequences.description: Path to file with custom barcode sequences.

in_aln_bam.description: Directly input aligned reads in BAM format.

in_draft_fastx.description: Directly input draft assembly for polishing in FASTA/FASTQ format.

-t/--threads.description: Number of threads for processing. 0 means unlimited.

-x/--device.description: Compute device: 'auto', 'cpu', 'cuda:all' or 'cuda:<device_id>[,<device_id>...]'. 'auto' chooses CPU or CUDA based on availability.

-o/--output-dir.description: Output directory. If not specified, output is written to stdout.

--models-directory.description: Directory to search for existing models or download new models into.

--bacteria.description: Optimize polishing for plasmids and bacterial genomes.

--vcf.description: Output a VCF file with variant calls to --output-dir if specified, otherwise to stdout.

--gvcf.description: Output a gVCF file to --output-dir if specified, otherwise to stdout.

--ambig-ref.description: Decode variants at ambiguous reference positions.

--draft-batchsize.description: Approximate batch size for processing input draft sequences.

--bam-chunk.description: Size of draft chunks to parse from the input BAM at a time.

--bam-subchunk.description: Size of regions to split the bam_chunk into for parallel processing.

--no-fill-gaps.description: Do not fill gaps in consensus sequence with draft sequence.

--fill-char.description: Use a designated character to fill gaps.

--regions.description: Process only these regions. Can be a path to a BED file or comma-separated Htslib-formatted regions (start is 1-based, end is inclusive).

--ignore-read-groups.description: Ignore read groups in BAM file.

--tag-name.description: Two-letter BAM tag name for filtering alignments during feature generation.

--tag-value.description: Value of the tag for filtering alignments during feature generation.

--tag-keep-missing.description: Keep alignments when tag is missing. If specified, overrides the same option in the model config.

--min-mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality of input alignments. If specified, overrides the same option in the model config.

--min-depth.description: Sites with depth lower than this value will not be processed.

reads.description: Path to file(s) with reads to trim. Can be in any HTS format. Can specify multiple files.

-t/--threads.description: Combined number of threads for adapter/primer detection and output generation. 0 uses all available threads.

-n/--max-reads.description: Maximum number of reads to process. Mainly for debugging. 0 processes all reads.

-k/--sequencing-kit.description: Sequencing kit name to use for selecting adapters and primers to trim.

--primer-sequences.description: Path to FASTA file with custom primer sequences, or name of a supported 3rd-party primer set (e.g. 10X_Genomics).

-l/--read-ids.description: File with newline-delimited list of reads to trim.

--emit-fastq.description: Output in FASTQ format. Default is BAM.

--no-trim-primers.description: Skip primer detection and trimming. Only adapters will be detected and trimmed.

index.description: Directly input reference index in FASTA/FASTQ or minimap2 .mmi format.

reads.description: Directly input reads file or folder containing reads in any HTS format.

-r/--recursive.description: If reads is a folder, recursively search subfolders for input files.

-o/--output-dir.description: If specified, write output files to this folder; otherwise, write to stdout. Required when reads is a folder.

--emit-summary.description: Emit a summary file containing details of the primary alignments for each read to the root of the output folder. Requires --output-dir.

--bed-file.description: Optional BED file. If specified, overlaps between alignments and BED entries are counted and recorded in BAM output using the 'bh' read tag.

-t/--threads.description: Number of threads for alignment and BAM writing. 0 means unlimited.

-n/--max-reads.description: Maximum number of reads to process (for debugging). 0 means unlimited.

--add-fastq-rg.description: Add FASTQ read group information as @RG header lines in the output BAM. Requires an initial pass over all input FASTQ files.

--mm2-opts.description: Optional minimap2 options string. For multiple arguments, surround the entire string with double quotes.

in_aln_bam.description: Directly input aligned reads in BAM format.

in_ref_fastx.description: Directly input reference sequences in FASTA/FASTQ format.

-t/--threads.description: Number of threads for processing. 0 means unlimited.

-x/--device.description: Compute device: 'auto', 'cpu', 'cuda:all' or 'cuda:<device_id>[,<device_id>...]'. 'auto' chooses CPU or all CUDA GPUs based on availability.

-o/--output-dir.description: Output directory. If not specified, output is written to stdout.

-m/--model.description: Path to the variant calling model folder. 'auto' lets dorado choose an appropriate model.

--gvcf.description: Output a gVCF instead of a VCF.

--ambig-ref.description: Decode variants at ambiguous reference positions.

-b/--batchsize.description: Batch size for inference. 0 enables auto batch size detection.

--ref-batchsize.description: Approximate batch size for processing input reference sequences.

--bam-chunk.description: Size of reference chunks to parse from the input BAM at a time.

--bam-subchunk.description: Size of regions to split the bam_chunk into for parallel processing.

--regions.description: Process only these regions. Can be a path to a BED file or a list of comma-separated Htslib-formatted regions (start is 1-based, end is inclusive).

--ignore-read-groups.description: Ignore read groups in the BAM file.

--tag-name.description: Two-letter BAM tag name for filtering alignments during feature generation.

--tag-value.description: Value of the tag for filtering alignments during feature generation.

--tag-keep-missing.description: Keep alignments when tag is missing. If specified, overrides the same option in the model config.

--min-mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality of the input alignments. If specified, overrides the same option in the model config.

--min-depth.description: Sites with depth lower than this value will not be processed.

--pass-qual-filter.description: Quality threshold for classifying variants as PASS.

--hp-tag.description: Use the HP tag from the input BAM file to load phasing information instead of computing it.

--unphased.description: Deactivate phasing and output unphased variants.
